english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is handled or described from general impressions rather than detailed understanding.

examples.english: I described that restaurant impressionistically, without researching it in detail.
examples.traditional: 我只係靠印象咁樣介紹嗰間餐廳，未有仔細研究。
